title: Planning gives a goal clause about the lookup revalidation a check that runs the lookup path, not factdiff.resolve alone
goal: A goal clause that names the lookup (pack --revalidate, the stored revalidation, a lookup's citation count) is read by a check that drives kbfacts.revalidate_pack or factdiff.revalidate on planted state, including a clone with no cached previous text and a stale_only pack, not only factdiff.resolve with hand-built inputs. Found in the SP-djl7za6x retrospective: every item check passed while the review found the lookup path still keeps a changed body by its section with no cached text (BG-vzsk2t5t) and narrows a row's citation count to its due sources (BG-7v7icnjj).
